experiments.hypothesis: Preserved baseline: preload *value before const aggregate initialization
experiments.result: Descriptor base allocated to r10 and the input value loaded too early.

experiments.hypothesis: Declare and initialize the const descriptor before loading *value
experiments.result: Extended live ranges forced r30/r31 saves and changed the aggregate copy.

experiments.hypothesis: Assign *value directly to word 7 after the const aggregate initialization
experiments.result: Recovered retail r11 descriptor base and exact tail stores, but alias conservatism delayed *value until the full aggregate copy completed.
